description: Return the full ISO 4217 currency catalogue as an array of `{ code, numeric, name, symbol }`. Use to resolve a currency name or symbol to its code, or to confirm a currency is supported before calling another tool, so a typo fails at selection rather than silently. Use `list_countries` for country codes. Non-ISO codes CNH, GGP, IMP, and JEP have an empty `numeric`. Returns the full list in one call and takes no parameters. Public tool: no sign-in and no API request billed.
name: list_currencies
title: Currency reference
